phrase.zh: 星系之间，也有相连的结构。
phrase.en: Structures connect the spaces between galaxies.

visual.zh: 星点与丝状光路组成网状空间，表达宇宙大尺度结构。明亮丝线是帮助观看的艺术处理，并不是肉眼能直接看见的发光绳索。
visual.en: Stars and filament-like paths form a network suggesting large-scale cosmic structure. The bright strands are an artistic aid, not glowing cords directly visible to the naked eye.

background.zh: NASA 在 2023 年介绍韦布望远镜识别的一条早期宇宙丝状结构，其长度约 300 万光年，围绕遥远的明亮类星体展开。这个数值指该项研究中的具体结构，不能用来代表所有宇宙丝状结构。
background.en: NASA reported in 2023 that Webb identified an early-universe filament about 3 million light-years long, anchored by a distant luminous quasar. That size belongs to the particular structure studied, not to all filaments in the cosmic web.

sources.label: NASA · Earliest strands of the cosmic web
